children: Exclusive Program Expands ShopRite Distribution Ahead of Labor Day
Utilizes Wakefern Backhaul Network to Enhance Supply-Chain Efficiency, Reduce Food Miles and Support Edible Garden’s Zero-Waste Inspired® Mission
BELVIDERE, NJ, Sept. 04, 2026
Edible Garden AG Incorporated (“Edible Garden” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: EDBL, EDBLW),

a leader in controlled environment agriculture (CEA), organic and sustainable produce, and developer of the Zero-Waste Inspired® mission and Farm-to-Formula® platform today announced that it has begun shipping what the Company believes to be the CEA industry’s first verified USDA Organic basil to Wakefern Food Corp. for distribution to participating ShopRite stores as part of an exclusive program. The expanded distribution comes ahead of Labor Day weekend, a period of increased demand for fresh herbs driven by grilling, entertaining and seasonal meal preparation, and provides ShopRite shoppers with access to fresh, certified organic basil grown using Edible Garden’s controlled environment agriculture platform and localized supply-chain model.

Edible Garden’s USDA Organic basil is grown in a controlled environment designed to provide greater consistency, quality and year-round availability while reducing reliance on long-distance supply chains. The basil is produced in accordance with USDA National Organic Program standards and independently verified by an accredited organic certifier.

“Bringing what we believe is the CEA industry’s first verified USDA Organic basil to Wakefern and participating ShopRite stores through this exclusive program represents an important expansion of our organic fresh herb offering and reflects our continued focus on innovation within the category,” said Jim Kras, Chief Executive Officer of Edible Garden. “Our goal is to give consumers the combination of organic integrity, freshness, and locally grown convenience they increasingly seek. Launching this product ahead of Labor Day also gives ShopRite shoppers a differentiated fresh herb option at a time when families are gathering, grilling, and preparing meals together.”

“Wakefern and its supermarket members have built a strong reputation for delivering fresh, high-quality products to their customers, and we are proud to expand our relationship with them. The program utilizes Wakefern’s backhaul logistics network, allowing our products to be picked up as part of existing transportation routes, which is designed to enhance supply-chain efficiency, reduce unnecessary food miles and further support our Zero-Waste Inspired® mission. We believe this program demonstrates the value of our controlled environment agriculture platform and localized distribution capabilities, while creating additional opportunities to grow our presence with major retail partners,” concluded Mr. Kras.
ABOUT EDIBLE GARDEN®

Edible Garden AG Incorporated is a leader in controlled environment agriculture (CEA), delivering organic, better-for-you, sustainable produce and products through its Zero-Waste Inspired® next-generation farming model. Available in over 6,000 retail locations across the United States, Caribbean, and South America, Edible Garden is at the forefront of the CEA and sustainability technology movement, distinguished by its advanced safety-in-farming protocols, sustainable packaging, patented GreenThumb software, and innovative Self-Watering in-store displays. The Company operates state-of-the-art, vertically integrated greenhouses and processing facilities, including Edible Garden Heartland in Grand Rapids, Michigan; Edible Garden Prairie Hills in Webster City, Iowa; and its headquarters at Edible Garden Belvidere in New Jersey. It also partners with a network of contract growers strategically located near major U.S. markets to ensure freshness and reduce environmental impact. The Company is also expanding its Prairie Hills facility in Webster City, Iowa, into a dedicated ready-to-drink (RTD) clean nutrition manufacturing hub, supporting its Farm-to-Formula® strategy and its transformation into higher-margin, shelf-stable nutrition categories.

Edible Garden’s proprietary GreenThumb 2.0 software—protected by U.S. Patents US 11,158,006 B1, US 11,410,249 B2, and US 11,830,088 B2—optimizes vertical and traditional greenhouse growing conditions while aiming to reduce food miles. Its patented Self-Watering display (U.S. Patent No. D1,010,365) is designed to extend plant shelf life and elevate in-store presentation. In addition to its core CEA operations, Edible Garden owns three patents in advanced aquaculture technologies: a closed-loop shrimp farming system (US 6,615,767 B1), a modular recirculating aquaculture setup with automated water treatment and feeding (US 10,163,199 B2), and a sensor-driven ammonia control method utilizing electrolytic chlorine generation (US 11,297,809 B1).

The Company has been recognized as a FoodTech 500 firm by Forward Fooding, is a multi-year participant in Walmart’s Project Gigaton and a Giga Guru designee and has received NRG’s Excellence in Energy Award for its commitment to measurable environmental performance and energy stewardship. Edible Garden also develops and markets a growing line of nutrition and specialty food products, including Vitamin Way® and Vitamin Whey®—plant and whey protein powders—and Kick. Sports Nutrition, a premium performance line for health-conscious athletes seeking cleaner, better-for-you options. The Company’s offerings further include fresh, sustainable condiments such as Pulp fermented gourmet and chili-based sauces, as well as Pickle Party, a collection of fermented fresh pickles and krauts.
